title: Browser Caching
definition: Browser caching stores copies of static web resources (HTML, CSS, JS, Images) on the user's local hard drive to avoid re-downloading them on subsequent visits.
simpleExplanation: The browser keeps a copy of the website's logo on your hard drive so you don't have to download it 100 times a day.
